requirements.quote: A usage-limit deferral is a known-time wait. It should hold until the reset and not count toward `max_deferrals`, like `sandbox.capacity` after #4528.
Any `deferred` result should be accepted by `--requeue`.

deliverables.change: deferPolicy handles rate_limited before the maxDeferrals cap; no deferral increment when pol.hold; comments updated (already on branch)
Regression tests for uncapped rate_limited and requeuable deferred (already on branch)
Spec: usage limit never capped; --requeue accepts deferred (already on branch)

Add '## Entry 2026-10-30 — Fix: usage-limit deferrals never capped; deferred requeuable (#4784)' ending with 'Cite: #4784.' so scripts/check-devdocs-freshness.sh passes for bin/lean/* (the orchestrate dossier glob is commands/orchestrate* only)

preserve.what: Other deferral codes (merge.transient, gh.unavailable, cli.idle, sandbox.start_failed, lease-held) still cap at maxDeferrals; bin/lean/orchestrate.mjs deferPolicy
host.busy and sandbox.capacity stay uncapped with host:true (bin/lean/batch.test.mjs #4528 tests)
Per-account holds still gate admission; requeue refusals for merged/unknown/not-in-batch issues unchanged (bin/lean/batch.mjs requeue)
bin/lean/lean.test.mjs orchestrate spec assertions on commands/orchestrate.md still match

decisions.choice: Keep rate_limited out of UNCAPPED_DEFERRALS (host:true, no hold) and special-case it before the cap in deferPolicy
decisions.justification: bin/lean/orchestrate.mjs deferPolicy: UNCAPPED returns host:true, which would drop the per-account hold
